title: Beyond Independent Passages: Adaptive Passage Combination Retrieval for Retrieval Augmented Open-Domain Question Answering
authors: Ting-Wen Ko; Jyun-Yu Jiang; Pu-Jen Cheng
why_relevant: Proposes an adaptive passage combination retrieval method that addresses redundancy and noise in retrieved passages and adaptive selection of number of passages, tangentially relevant to noisy retrieval.
why_not_or_caveat: Main focus is improving multi-hop ODQA retrieval quality, not robustness, calibration, conflict, or adversarial settings.
